g.text: > review this branch
Here's a detailed review of the branch. I went
through all 14 changed files and found several
things worth discussing in depth:
## 1. State handling in useBudget.ts
The hook recomputes the total on every render
because the dependency array includes the whole
items object rather than its stable id. This
matters because the parent re-renders on every
keystroke, so the reducer runs ~40 times per...
## 2. Empty state of the transaction list
When the API returns an empty array the list
renders nothing at all, which looks like a bug
to the user. Consider rendering the EmptyState...
## 3. Naming
`handleClick2` and `tmpData` should be renamed...
